description: This PHP source file defines the BillingConductorClient class in the AWS SDK, which is used to interact with the AWS Billing Conductor service. It declares various methods for billing account management and associated operations, primarily via method annotations.

classes.name: BillingConductorClient
classes.description: A client class used for interacting with the AWS Billing Conductor service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateAccounts
methods.description: Associates accounts with the billing conductor.

methods.name: associateAccountsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates accounts with the billing conductor.

methods.name: createBillingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new billing group.

methods.name: updateBillingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing billing group.
